svg.text: Tower B · Learning Center · Levels 00–04 (Tower A rotated 180°, bridge side toward A)

Structure as placed in Rhino: 18 frames at 20° from 4.9°, column rings r 2.06 / 5.49 / 9.14 / 11.43 / 13.72 m, floors at z 20.2 · 24.5 · 28.1 · 31.8 · 35.5 m, the bridge landing on the 28.1 floor, both existing stairs kept. One bar on the bridge side between the r 9.14 and r 13.72 rings, partitions on the frames; open floor to the forest. Schematic, 2 November 2026.
